images.title: Numbers between two numbers
images.purpose: Show the numbers 71,500, 71,900 and 72,000 lying between 71,420 and 72,050 on a number line.
images.composition: A number line with a grey dot at each end, 3 green dots between them with number cards above, the end numbers below and a brace marking the numbers between.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. A horizontal thick dark line with plain ends from x = 130 to x = 1326 at about y = 400. Left end: a grey #6B7280 filled circle (radius 22) at x = 130 with the number 71,420 under it. Right end: a grey filled circle at x = 1326 with the number 72,050 under it. The end numbers are bold dark numerals (52 px). 3 green #009E73 filled circles (radius 22) on the line between the ends, at 0.127, 0.762 and 0.921 of the way from left to right (x = 282, 1041 and 1232). Above each circle, joined by a short vertical leader, a rounded card about 200 by 80 px with a green outline and bold dark numerals (48 px): 71,500 above the first circle, 71,900 above the second, 72,000 above the third. The cards sit at about y = 250. The 72,000 card has a thick reddish purple #CC79A7 outline, and above it a pill tag, right-aligned to x = 1420 (about y = 150), reading 0 in ones, tens and hundreds (36 px, dark), joined to the card by a short tick. Below the line and the end numbers, a reddish purple #CC79A7 brace opening upwards from x = 160 to x = 1296 at about y = 620, with the text numbers between centred under it (46 px, dark).
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A number between two numbers is greater than the smaller one and less than the bigger one, and there are many such numbers.
images.description: A number line from 71,420 to 72,050 with grey end dots and three green dots for 71,500, 71,900 and 72,000, a brace marked numbers between, and a tag saying 72,000 has 0 in ones, tens and hundreds.
images.context: Concept image for Numbers between two numbers. Your maths book has no figure for this idea, only the questions, so the number line is built from the video's own example, 71,420 and 72,050.
images.teaching_notes: Many answers are right; these three are one choice. Check each against both ends. The ringed 72,000 is a whole number of thousands, so its ones, tens and hundreds digits are all 0.

image_decisions.why: A number line with two ends and numbers between them shows what between means and that many answers fit.
